items.headline: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 144-yard quarter sparks Seahawks in win over Raiders
items.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, the NFL's leading receiver, finished with a season-high 171 yards on eight catches, with 144 coming in the third quarter to help the Seahawks turn a three-point halftime deficit into a 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
